node.27994712d6e50c0a1c05dea6.distinction: The prior models already identify the relevant actors, distinguish channel from method, preserve the launch boundary and separate submission, contact, migration and resubmission events. The consequential remaining defect is the certificate relationship. Model abstraction.c8a341a59885fb7db63017bf makes certificate availability sufficient under an explicit assumption. Model abstraction.ebfcf1c1217258fc2b8613f9 instead requires supply or use 'in the manner required', but the required manner remains unspecified. The retained footnote supports a requirement for the particular submission; it does not resolve availability versus the operational act needed to satisfy that requirement. This proposal therefore withholds a complete compliance formula pending that information. It does not invent a rival signing, attachment or authentication requirement. Splitting the PDF components also prevents the file's format from concealing an incomplete form or a missing upload.

node.c8e005eb37a38e37e6a09f74.distinction: An urgent matter at 8:30am on 2 February remains within the blackout contact arrangement; one at 9:30am falls within the post-launch channel control. node.d2ff2a2cac0086fe5b2c2725.distinction: Choosing a permitted XML format under the selected filing control does not exhaust XML-specific duties. The text requires schema conformity and prompt liaison, but does not expressly make successful test completion a filing prerequisite.

node.d2ff2a2cac0086fe5b2c2725.statement: Licensed firms intending to submit XML STRs must follow the separately provided JFIU schema and liaise with the JFIU as soon as possible to arrange a technical test. assumptions: The filing entity is classified separately under the circular's definition of licensed firms; no classification is inferred from its use of STREAMS 2.
The specific 9:00am launch and resumption provision determines the post-launch boundary for this model when read with the general effective-date provision.
Each assessed event has an identifiable submission method; a later resubmission is a separate event.
Footnote 3 applies to the XML and PDF alternatives carrying its marker. No e-Cert requirement for the web-based alternative is inferred from this footnote.
Certificate satisfaction means that a Hongkong Post e-Cert is supplied or used for this particular submission in the required manner; mere firm-level possession does not establish that fact.

The result covers only the selected channel, method and certificate requirements. It does not decide the STR's substantive adequacy, filing timeliness, XML schema conformity, technical testing or overall legal compliance.

node.e527b70be44a95d97a2e5ae5.distinction: A single fact such as electronic_submission would conceal the distinction between channel and format, while firm_has_ecert would conceal the submission-specific certificate requirement. XML and PDF require both the STREAMS 2 channel and the footnote 3 certificate condition. The retained text does not attach that certificate condition to the web-based alternative. The blackout is excluded from this ordinary post-launch rule.

node.e527b70be44a95d97a2e5ae5.statement: [TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT] For an in-scope post-launch submission by a classified licensed firm, true means that the STR was submitted to the JFIU through STREAMS 2 using XML with the required Hongkong Post e-Cert, a completed prescribed PDF form with that e-Cert, or the completed STREAMS 2 web-based STR form. node.f75383097facdc52b0ac66f7.distinction: Retains the parent's channel-and-method reading while repairing its unresolved is_xml_submission reference. Footnote 2 attaches a further duty to an off-channel filing; it does not make that original filing compliant if later resubmitted. The competing hypothesis that footnote 2 permits alternative initial channels fails because its text requires resubmission without granting permission or retrospective cure. Extending footnote 3 to the web form likewise lacks an anchor. The strongest remaining uncertainty is the operational meaning of satisfying the certificate requirement.

assumptions: The firm is separately classified within the circular's definition of licensed firms.
Implementation for the footnote 2 trigger begins at the stated 9:00am launch on 2 February 2026.
The event history distinguishes a contact, a submission, a resubmission and an automatic record migration.
The footnote 2 trigger quantifies over submissions of this same STR: at least one qualifying post-implementation submission is sufficient to trigger the stated resubmission requirement.
The blackout urgent-contact instruction is retained as a distinct transitional instruction and is not treated as permission to use alternative channels after launch.
The retained footnote does not by itself extend the resubmission trigger to contacts or submissions occurring only during the blackout.
Triggering the requirement and subsequently discharging it are separate questions. The trigger remains historically true after a successful resubmission.

node.fc565a946804e1633024b4d3.distinction: Reviewing the submission-event model exposes a missing relation between multiple events concerning the same STR. A single off_platform Boolean would conflate urgent blackout contact, a post-launch alternative-channel submission and an automatically migrated old record. Only the second supplies the stated footnote 2 trigger. A later STREAMS 2 resubmission cannot make the original event comply with the exclusive-channel requirement, and the fact that a trigger occurred does not establish an outstanding or overdue obligation.

This externally supplied factual aggregate expresses the event quantifier absent from the formula language.

node.fc565a946804e1633024b4d3.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] True means that the assessed licensed firm's STR has at least one submission to the JFIU through a channel other than STREAMS 2 following implementation, so the stated requirement to resubmit that STR through STREAMS 2 is triggered. False means that no such qualifying submission exists in the established event history. Unknown or incomplete event history must not be treated as false. This answers whether the resubmission trigger occurred, not whether the firm has complied with or discharged the obligation. Separately, an STR requiring urgent submission during the blackout calls for direct JFIU contact by email, phone or fax; that instruction is not evaluated by this trigger. These proposed meanings confer no legal approval.
node.fc565a946804e1633024b4d3.subject: Resubmission trigger distinguished from blackout contact and subsequent discharge

node.ffbffced8482e825ba2e9b76.distinction: The blackout arrangement attaches to urgency during a bounded interval, not to urgency at any time. It therefore does not supply a continuing post-launch exception. A hypothesis that every listed contact method completes filing or automatically triggers footnote 2 lacks support. The source does not settle follow-up for blackout-only submissions.
questions: What constitutes completed urgent filing through the blackout arrangements, and what later follow-up is required?
node.ffbffced8482e825ba2e9b76.statement: For an STR requiring urgent submission during the blackout, licensed firms are directed to contact JFIU through a listed email, phone or fax method. This instruction remains separate from the post-launch channel control and does not establish that contact alone completes filing.
